Case reference: 2003006900.CaseDesc: Krzysztof Syrzycki was last seen in Coquitlam, British Columbia on June 29, 2002.

Case reference: 2013000092.CaseDesc: Jacques Boulanger was last seen on September 1, 1989 in Montreal, Quebec. Jacques loved sleeping outside even though he had a home and was a cabinetmaker in his spare time.  He might have a scar on his leg or foot.

Case reference: 2016068940.CaseDesc: On December 8, 2016, Cory Lanteigne was reported missing by family members after having gone out for a short walk, and never returning. It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2012020147.CaseDesc: On March 25, 1996, the skeletal remains of a man were found near the Upper Levels Highway in West Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had recovered from severe injuries to his right arm and leg. He also had a fractured skull, nose and ribs. These injuries were likely a result of a single major accident. It is estimated that he may have died several months prior to the discovery of his remains.

He then boarded a taxi. David inquired about the cost of transportation to the Ottawa, Ontario area with the driver. Due to insufficient funds, he exited the vehicle and continued his journey on Route 289. David was subsequently seen heading in a southerly direction towards Saint-Alexandre. We have not received any information regarding David's whereabouts since that time. Additionally, he has not been adhering to his prescribed medication regimen.

Case reference: 2016068715.CaseDesc: On July 21, 2013, the body of an adult male was found floating in the Niagara River across from the Youngstown Marina, NY, USA near the Niagara-On-The-Lake Sailing Club, Ontario, Canada. Anthropological analysis has suggested that he is black, although there are some features which suggest that he may be mixed Black and Caucasian. He is described as obese however this may be due to post-mortem changes. He is thought to have been in the water for at least one year to possibly several years.

His mother went to his apartment where she found packages that were prepared for different people. Jean-Jacques' personal belongings and clothes had disappeared.

Case reference: 2014003815.CaseDesc: Monica Cardinal was reported missing to the Edmonton Police Service in February, 1997. Monica was last seen leaving a downtown hotel with an unknown male in June, 1993.

Case reference: 2014006178.CaseDesc: An investigation revealed that nobody had seen or heard from Alex Klym since the mid 1970's. The family had made attempts to locate Alex, but they were unsuccessful and nobody ever reported that he was missing. Inquiries were made with various government agencies in an attempt to find some evidence of him after the mid 1970's. There is no trace of him. The body of Alex has never been recovered. It is not known what happened to Alex, but foul play cannot be ruled out.

Case reference: 2014004877.CaseDesc: On February 9, 2006, Michelle Mercer was seen for the last time walking away from an argument with her boyfriend, in the area of 105 Street and 69 Avenue in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014005526.CaseDesc: Angela Meyer was last seen at her parent's residence on November 27, 2010 in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories.  Angela was on a weekend pass from Stanton Territorial Hospital and was under the legal guardianship of her mother.  Angela was taking various medications and did not take the medications with her when she went missing.

Jacket: Nylon, Red, Black, Hip length, black on the back of sleeves

Case reference: 2018060326.CaseDesc: On June 10, 2018, sisters Bérénice and Bérengère Paré were last seen at the Ottawa International Airport in Ottawa, Ontario. Bérénice and Bérengère, along with their mother, boarded a flight destined for Russia to visit with family. To date, the siblings have not been returned to Canada.

Case reference: 2009003899.CaseDesc: Emile Ruger, a resident of Brookdale Ave. in Cornwall, Ontario, had not paid his rent for the months of March and April 2008.  Emile's standard practice is to pay his rent three days in advance at the start of each month. The last confirmed sighting of Emile was in mid-February 2008 in Cornwall, and there have been no further reported sightings. There are indications that he has associates in the Hawkesbury, ON area.

Case reference: 2014005770.CaseDesc: On August 29, 1979, Thomas Lidguerre and Lawrence Sanger headed out from Fond du Lac to Uranium City on Lake Athabaska, Saskatchewan. The boat was located two days later, swamped near the Narrows and Popular Point. A search was conducted and lasted for over one month without any success in locating Thomas and Lawrence.

Case reference: 2014004643.CaseDesc: On July 28, 2002, Carol Tuks was last seen while exiting a Greyhound bus in Red Deer, Alberta.

Shirt: Black, Blue, Size Small or Medium; unknown style
Pierce: Ears, Single piercing in each ear

Case reference: 2014001413.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1959, Captain Charles David Tillsley, Warrant Officer Tyrus Cobb, Sergeant Major James Mackey, and a fourth companion left Fort Churchill on a weekend fishing trip on the Churchill River in Manitoba. They were last seen loading their gear into a boat at the Churchill Dock at around 1 p.m. They were due back on September 20, but failed to return. Fort Churchill's military authorities commenced a search with the aid of helicopters and aircraft. On September 21, the two boats used by the men were located; both were undamaged and swamped. Numerous items belonging to the four men were found. Despite extensive land and water searches, the bodies were not found.

Case reference: 2014001590.CaseDesc: On May 1, 1990, Claude L'Heureux was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Claude had worked in bars in The Village district of Montreal, Quebec. No one has seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2014003132.CaseDesc: On December 29, 1978, Sharon Drover was seen for the last time in downtown St. John's, Newfoundland & Labrador. Sharon left her boarding house located on Livingstone Street and arrived for her evening shift at the McDonald’s restaurant located on Kenmount Road where she finished her shift after midnight.  Investigators believe Sharon intended to hitchhike home after her shift.

Case reference: 2014006326.CaseDesc: Ronald Kay was reported missing to the Regina Police Service on November 26, 2013. He was last seen at the Saskatchewan Rough Riders Football game and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014003214.CaseDesc: On November 24, 1982, Clyde "Van" Ditmars was reported missing to the Thunder Bay Police Service by his family. Van sought work in British Columbia, Alberta and Manitoba in the early 1980s as a welder. Since being reported missing, Van's family has not heard from him and his whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2014006557.CaseDesc: Alvin Berg hails from Pierceland District, Saskatchewan. He was employed as a farm labourer in the Spinney Hill district near Maymont, SK. Alvin was last seen when he left this farm in October 1940, after which he had no further contact with his family.

Case reference: 2014032043.CaseDesc:

Mrs. Sisson was reported to be an alcoholic who occasionally went missing for several days at a time. She also suffered from dementia. 
 
Mrs. Sisson's last surviving son has since passed away.  There was never any indication of foul play in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014006256.CaseDesc: Christopher Maier lives in Saskatoon and traveled to Regina, Saskatchewan in December 1994 to visit family and friends. He was believed to have returned to Saskatoon after his visit, although this has not been confirmed. Case reference: 2014003250.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1974, four people left the Whitedog Indian Reserve, Ontario in a 14' Lund boat and were heading for Pointe du Bois, Manitoba. Their intention was to go to Pointe du Bois to pick up supplies and then return to Whitedog. On November 5, 1974, these individuals were reported missing as they had never returned to Whitedog.  It is believed that the boat overturned and everyone drowned. Two bodies were recovered, and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. Searches were conducted by boat and by air but the bodies of Paul Scott and Richard Petawanahqueb were never recovered.  Paul and Richard are presumed dead due to drowning. No foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2014001617.CaseDesc: On January 25, 1976, Camille Lessard was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. Case reference: 2012020121.CaseDesc: Mathieu Beauregard Messier was at home with his wife on April 30, 2008 in Farnham, Quebec. At approximately 10:30 p.m. that night, police received a call that a vehicle was on fire on Rang du Haut-de-la-Rivière, near the military base in Farnham. The vehicle was identified as that of Mathieu’s wife, there was nobody inside the vehicle and Mathieu has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2012020047.CaseDesc: Joseph Thomas Zerk was last seen on December 1, 2008 in Edmonton, Alberta. He was dealing with some medical issues and had experienced periods of homelessness.

Case reference: 2018039090.CaseDesc: On December 6, 1996, at approximately 10:00 a.m., San Lee was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, San was terminally ill and despondent.

Case reference: 2019041758.CaseDesc: On July 2, 2019, Brany Rodriguez was last seen in Waterloo, Ontario.  He was known to lead a transient lifestyle and had previously stayed in all three cities in the Region of Waterloo. His whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2020028363.CaseDesc: On July 20, 2020, around 9:00 a.m., Sumira Rashid was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec when she left her family home. Sumira left home with a sports bag under the pretext of going shopping but she never returned and has not been seen since. An investigation concluded that Sumira later took a flight to Los Angeles, California.

Case reference: 2012020081.CaseDesc: Emily Osmond (Laplante) lived a reclusive lifestyle on a small acreage on the Northern edge of Kawacatoose First Nation. Emily seldom had contact with her family or friends and the last known contact with them was August 29, 2007. She was last seen on the 9th of September, 2007, by her hired helper. Her disappearance is very unusual. Her vehicle and personal belongings including medication were left at her residence. She also had dogs at her acreage that she cared for that were left unattended. Searches of the area have failed to locate any sign of Emily.

Case reference: 2016060399.CaseDesc: On October 3, 1975, the skeletal remains of a male were found in the brush on Sparrow Lake Road (Lot 23 Con 14) in Orillia. His post-mortem length was recorded as being between 5'8"-5'9" however; this measurement may not represent his actual living height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.  A pair of nail clippers was also found nearby. His death is estimated to have occurred in the spring or summer prior.

Case reference: 2014002684.CaseDesc: Mathieu Landry was reported missing on February 16, 1994, by a traveling companion, while on vacation in Malaysia. Mathieu was renting a cabin at Juara village on Tioman Island in Malaysia, when he went for a walk and never returned. Mathieu's passport, clothing, backpack and other personal effects where recovered from the resort where he was staying and sunglasses belonging to him were found on the beach. Land and water searches involving police divers were done and failed to locate him, Mathieu is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2006020599.CaseDesc: Simon Angeconeb was last seen on July 10, 1993 at Cat Island Lodge located on Red Lake in the District of Kenora, Ontario. He was heading to his cabin to go to sleep and has not been seen since. He may have been suffering from a concussion.

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2014041668.CaseDesc: Lise Fredette was last seen leaving work in the city of Peterborough on the evening of November 12, 2014. Richard Rodrigue was concerned that night had fallen and Bernard had not returned to his cabin.  Richard informed the authorities, who conducted a search with the assistance of a police canine unit and helicopter, but were unable to locate Bernard.
